text: 'Farg'ona Invest Kompaniyasi' AJ was founded by the Fergana region administration (hokimlik).
short: Farg'ona Invest was founded by, and is solely owned by, the Fergana regional government.

source.name: Farg'ona Invest Kompaniyasi AJ: Uzbekistan Republic, Fergana region hokim's decision 163-11-0-Q/26 (charter annexe)
source.quote: Farg‘ona viloyati hokimligi muassisligida tadbirkorlik subyektlari va davlat organlari o‘rtasida “ko‘prik” vazifasini bajaruvchi “Farg‘ona invest kompaniyasi” aksiyadorlik jamiyati (keyingi o‘rinlarda —Kompaniya) tashkil etilsin.

additionalSources.name: Lex.uz: Presidential decree PF-29 of 24.02.2026 (On measures to accelerate housing provision)
additionalSources.quote: viloyatlar hokimliklari bir oy muddatda “Toshkent Invest kompaniyasi” AJ va “Samarqand Invest kompaniyasi” AJ tajribasi asosida aksiyadorlik jamiyati shaklida
additionalSources.note: Clause 6 orders the regional hokimliks to establish the investment companies as joint-stock companies; appendix 6 lists them as founded by the administrations.
